subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the first frame of [Shot 1], showing <Subject 1> on a burning ancient battlefield, both arms extended sideways with a curved crescent scimitar in each hand, dark red gauze battle skirt and long dark hair pushed by hot wind, embers drifting past, ruined siege towers and tattered banners under a heavy overcast sky.
<Picture 2> is the character-design reference sheet for <Subject 1>, showing a face close-up plus front, side, and back full-body views: a young East Asian woman with long dark hair swept up under an elaborate bronze-gold filigree crown with dangling bead chains, off-shoulder dark red bodice with embossed bronze-gold chest armor, matching segmented bronze-gold arm greaves, layered dark red gauze skirt with torn asymmetric hems, and dark leather boots.
<Subject 1> is the female war goddess in <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>, armed with two ornate bronze-gold crescent scimitars whose edges carry a faint molten-gold sheen, wearing dark red and bronze-gold fantasy Chinese armor, a filigree crown, and long dark hair.

summary:
[keyframe completion + reference generation] The target video is an 8-second stylized fantasy action sequence continuing from <Picture 1>, grounded martial movement amplified with layered visual effects: molten-gold blade trails, crescent-shaped flying slash waves, ember vortices, and arc-shaped shockwaves. <Subject 1> fights through the enemy line with twin crescent scimitars in a chain-relay assault — cutting down a banner pole and vaulting off its falling shaft, splitting a spear row with one trailing flying-slash wave, leaping off a shield into a crossing double cut wrapped in an ember vortex, then landing a full-speed horizontal sweep that releases a fan-shaped shockwave hurling a shield rank into a collapsing siege tower, settling with a spark line rising as glowing embers. <Picture 1> supplies the first-frame composition and pose; <Picture 2> supplies the costume, crown, hairstyle, and weapon details for character retention.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] first frame): fully_preserved - the low-angle battlefield stance, twin extended crescent scimitars, dark red and bronze-gold armor, wind-driven hair and gauze skirt, drifting embers, ruined siege towers, and tattered banners are retained as the opening frame.
<Picture 2> (costume reference for all shots): fully_preserved - the off-shoulder dark red bodice, embossed bronze-gold chest armor, segmented arm greaves, layered dark red gauze skirt, filigree crown with bead chains, long dark hair, and twin ornate crescent scimitars are retained throughout.
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1] through [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - facial features, body type, armor, weapons, hair, and crown stay consistent; only pose, camera angle, dynamic states, and effect intensity change.

detailed_description:
The target video is a stylized fantasy action sequence with a desaturated ash-heavy palette, high-contrast firelight, and grounded physical martial movement amplified by a consistent effect language: every scimitar arc leaves a molten-gold light trail, every full-power cut releases a crescent-shaped pressure wave, and battlefield embers and ash respond to her motion as vortices and drift, all in bronze-gold and ember-orange tones matching her armor and the burning field.
[Shot 1] At 00:00.000, the video begins from <Picture 1>. A low-angle close shot: <Subject 1>'s right scimitar is already mid-swing, the upward crescent cut shearing through a tilted tattered banner pole, the blade edge dragging a bright molten-gold crescent trail that hangs in the air for a beat before dissolving into embers. The severed pole drops trailing its torn red banner, burning banner cloth bursting into a fan of orange sparks at the cut point; she steps onto the sliding shaft with her left boot and borrows its fall to launch into a forward sprint, gauze skirt and hair snapping, the gold trail's embers streaming off her blade behind her. The camera whips horizontally along the falling pole's direction and picks up her sprint mid-stride.
[Shot 2] At 00:01.000, a long lateral tracking medium shot follows her into the enemy line: her left scimitar parries an incoming spear upward in a spray of sparks, her right scimitar answers with a reverse cut that shears the shaft in half, a shoulder check sends a shield-bearer staggering sideways, and without breaking stride she drags the right blade into one long diagonal slash — the blade's gold trail detaches into a crescent-shaped flying slash wave that races ahead of her arm and runs through an entire row of three braced spears, each shaft splitting in sequence as the wave passes with a hair's delay between cracks, spark fans bursting at every break, all shafts toppling in the same direction she is running. Dust kicks from her boots and speed lines trail along her advance as she steps over the falling shafts without pausing.
[Shot 3] At 00:02.800, a low wide angle from in front of the shield line: she plants a boot on a raised shield, the shield face denting inward with a burst of dust and a ring-shaped shock ripple spreading across the ground around the impact, and vaults upward; a vortex of embers and ash spirals up around her body with the launch, and mid-air her twin scimitars scissor through a crossing double cut, their molten-gold trails crossing into a glowing X of light against the smoke, ember particles whipping around the blades in two counter-rotating curls. The camera tilts up from below following her ascent.
[Shot 4] At 00:04.000, the heavy strike at full speed with no slow motion: the instant she lands, the impact point cracks the ground in a small radial star and she converts the drop into a single-armed horizontal sweep — the blade releases a broad fan-shaped shockwave, visible as a shimmering bronze-gold pressure crescent, that slams into an entire rank of shield-wielding soldiers and hurls them off their feet and out of frame right ahead of the blade's own arc, shields and men tumbling together with debris trailing ember sparks. The camera whip-pans after the flying wave as it and the bodies crash into a burning siege tower in the background — the tower's skeletal frame snaps and collapses in a cascade of sparks and ash, a brief two-frame white flash and a sharp camera shake marking the impact, a radial shock ring puffing outward through the smoke.
[Shot 5] At 00:06.000, a low-angle medium shot for the settle: she halts her momentum by dragging the right scimitar's tip through the scorched earth, the tip plowing a long line of orange sparks whose afterglow lingers, then lifts off the ground as a scatter of slow-rising glowing embers. She straightens amid the falling ash rain from the collapsed tower, crown bead chains and layered gauze skirt drifting a beat behind her body, the last of the gold trail fading off her blade in drifting sparks, gaze fixed into the smoke ahead. The camera pushes in slowly and holds as embers drift through the frame.

overall_soundscape:
The burning battlefield ambience persists throughout: distant fire crackle, hot wind gusting through ruins, tattered banners flapping. Physical and effect sounds follow the action: the wood-crack of the banner pole shearing and cloth whipping as it falls, a bright metallic ring layered under each molten-gold blade trail, the scrape of her boot sliding down the shaft, steel-on-steel clangs and grinding sparks during the parry, three sequential spear-shaft cracks each with a rising airy whoosh from the flying slash wave, the low boom and ground-crack of the landing, a deep rushing swell as the fan-shaped shockwave launches, the mass crash of soldiers and shields hitting the siege tower, timber snapping and collapsing, debris and ash raining down, and the soft crackle of the spark line lifting into glowing embers.

non_diegetic_music:
An intense orchestral action score drives the sequence: urgent tremolo strings from the first frame, low taiko-style drums entering with her sprint, a brass stab under the shield vault, percussion dropping out for a half-beat at the horizontal sweep impact then slamming back with the full ensemble as the tower collapses, and a closing descent to sustained low strings with a single deep drum hit as the embers rise.
